test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

Who keeps the accounts of this hotel?

options.text: By whom have the accounts of this hotel been kept?
By whom are the accounts being kept of this hotel?
By whom are the accounts of this hotel kept?
By whom the account is being kept of this hotel?

solution:
The correct answer is '**By whom are the accounts of this hotel kept?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The given above sentence is in an 'active voice form', hence we need to convert it into a 'passive voice form'.
 
• In an active voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In a passive voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• We need to follow these **instructions **while changing the** voice of an interrogative sentence**.
 
 
• When the Interrogative Sentence starts from **Why/When and How**, then we should use t**hem in starting of the sentences** and **who **should replace by **By Whom**.
 
• **Helping verb** **comes before the object** in the **passive voice,** (as passive voice start with object of the active voice)
 
• Convert the** verb into past participle or 3rd form** of the verb.
 
• Complete the sentence with the subject and **sign of Interrogation (?)**.
 
 
 
• Let's have a look at the **structural form** of the given rule:
 
 
• **Who/Why/When/How + auxiliary + subject + verb + object ? (active voice)**
 
• **By whom/Why/When/How + auxiliary + object + V3 + by + subject? (passive voice)****​**
 
 
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the** interrogative Sentences that start with the word 'Wh'.**
 
• **Example: **
 
 
• ***​**Who wrote this letter? (active voice)*
 
• *By whom was this letter written? (passive voice)**​*
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that ‘By whom are the accounts of this hotel kept?’ is the correct passive form of the given sentence.
